name: blast_radius

test_list.description: Expand a recursive delete against an injected workspace view and account unique bytes and dirty paths.
Recognize only command forms whose semantics match the selected shell dialect.
Treat shell composition, variable expansion, path escape and unsupported redirects as Critical unknowns.
Report dirty paths matched by an operation even when the current tree no longer contains them.
Deduplicate provider entries for affected paths and byte accounting.
Exercise arbitrary command bytes and preserve the unknown-is-critical invariant.
Account all affected files and bytes in a 100,000-file injected view.
Run 100,000 mixed shell commands through the public estimator while preserving fail-closed behavior.
Measure the classifier itself over 100,000 mixed shell commands, without workspace accounting.

inputs.name: view
inputs.description: Injected file facts and uncommitted path set.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Shell dialect, command text, workspace directory and policy limits.

output_description: A conservative file-effect estimate. Unknown command shape is Critical.
